definition: A Subordination, Non-Disturbance and Attornment Agreement sets the priority of a lease relative to a lender's interest and defines possession and tenancy obligations following foreclosure.
entry_text: A Subordination, Non-Disturbance and Attornment Agreement sets the priority of a lease relative to a lender's interest and defines possession and tenancy obligations following foreclosure.
example: A commercial tenant negotiates continued occupancy after foreclosure if it remains in compliance with its lease.
label: Subordination, Non-Disturbance and Attornment Agreement
